notes.title: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42931488/9d6aad1b6b0dd63fd1204a7e1a15c7c9027da930.png[/img]

Hello performers!

StarMaker VR has been released for almost two months, thanks to you all who supported our game, you guys gave us lots of helpful feedback and helped us improve our game and make it better all the time. 

We have found a better way to bring our game to more players and it's time to expand our communities. So now, we want to change our service to free testing. It's our opportunity to provide our game to everyone who loves singing and music, receive more advice from more people all over the world, and expand our player base as well. 

So for the free testing version, we will still bring a lot of improvements to you in the future and add more interesting content and songs in every single mode, also other small music games. Maybe we will change to paid again in the future, but now it's definitely the best time to try StarMaker VR, please get ready for the next coming version and share this news with as many friends as you can!
